headline: Palantine Berm Ignites As Northern Fronts Grind Through Heavy Slaughter
war_summary: Fresh violence has flared along the Palantine Berm, where a sharp two-hour push saw Leiri Hermanni fall to Colonial forces amidst rapidly accelerating enlistments and casualties. Meanwhile, the northern bloodbaths at Mooring County and Weathered Expanse show no respite: both sectors logged over four thousand combined casualties across the past two hours, with Mooring County recording three further base turnovers and Weathered Expanse remaining partially fractured by a neutral strongpoint. To the west, Nevish Line has suddenly detonated into furious combat, devouring over twenty-seven hundred men in two hours despite no recorded changes in base ownership. Active skirmishing also persists in Stlican Shelf, where Fort Hoarfrost changed hands again during recent clashes, leaving six bases under Colonial control against three Warden redoubts. In contrast, the Dead Lands front has cooled to a crawl, and the guns across Farranac Coast and Stonecradle remain largely dormant after their earlier convulsions.
